secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: HS256 signing secret for session JWTs (any random 32+ char string). Required for auth to function securely.

secrets.name: SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Owner password for the admin portal (see README "First login"). At least 12 chars. There is no default: without it the owner account stays locked (fail closed).

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: PostgreSQL connection string for V2 (Neon/Supabase/RDS), with the existing NexaTrade schema. Required by v2-api; only the legacy web service supports embedded PGlite without it.

secrets.name: FINNHUB_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional — improves forex/commodity/stock live quotes. Crypto uses Binance public WebSocket (no key).

secrets.name: POLYGON_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional — alternative market data provider for forex/stocks.

secrets.name: NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional — enables automatic crypto deposit invoices via nowpayments.io.

secrets.name: NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional — IPN secret for nowpayments.io payment webhooks.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID
secrets.description: Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID (format: G-XXXXXXXXXX). Create one at analytics.google.com → Admin → Create Account/Property → Data Stream (Web). Empty = GA disabled. This is a public ID visible in client-side code, not a private secret.
